decisions.statement: A talosconfig that is not there refuses the bootstrap.
The talosconfig read sits at `<home>/.talos/<cluster>.config`, where `akasha talos apply` writes it.
talosctl writes its own progress to the streams the call was made on.
The node bootstrapped is the node the address names.
The node bootstrapped is its own endpoint.
Nothing here says whether the cluster was bootstrapped before.
Every answer here is built by a function rather than written out as a value.

definition: the command starting etcd on one Talos control-plane node
